name: should-compact
description: Score 0-10 whether NOW is a good moment to compact a coding-agent session, and say why in one line. Scores the BOUNDARY rather than the token count: an open tool chain or a half-finished edit is a hard zero however full the window is, which is the signal that decided 98.07% of holds across 1,089 measured turns. Reads only a hot buffer of recent turns plus an append-only two-tier session log it maintains itself, so it stays cheap enough for Haiku-class models and fast enough to sit in a PreCompact hook — where it can veto an ill-timed automatic compaction, and never vetoes at the wall. Pairs with braindump, handing it the log's verbatim fact tier as grounding.
